a more than $700M long-term services agreement with La Compagnie du TransGuinéen for its new Evolution Series locomotive fleet.
The deal, combined with Wabtec’s 2024 locomotive orders, brings its total Simandou project value to more than $1.2B.
The agreement will support CTG’s 600+ kilometer TransGuinean Railway, linking the Simandou mine with the Port of Morebaya.
Services include maintenance, parts overhauls, logistics, training, remote diagnostics, and parts management, along with workforce development and local partnerships.
The contract covers CTG’s ES43AC locomotives powered by 4,500-horsepower Evolution Series engines.

title: Wabtec secures $700M+ Simandou services deal
